ee51e817-a25c-429c-892c-2b09b8aec404.suggestedTitle: Predefined serverless Security roles now include the Manage templates privilege
ee51e817-a25c-429c-892c-2b09b8aec404.summary: The PR adds the cases_manage_templates sub-privilege (feature_securitySolutionCasesV3.cases_manage_templates) to the local serverless role fixtures used by the kbn-es test tooling, mirroring a change in elasticsearch-controller that grants it to predefined Security roles with full Cases access (for example editor, T2/T3 analyst, rule author, SOC manager, detections admin). ad5a6dd1-f637-49f7-a50a-651e55776324.suggestedTitle: Create and replace case attachments with the new unified attachments API (internal)
ad5a6dd1-f637-49f7-a50a-651e55776324.summary: Adds the write path of the new unified attachments API for Cases: POST /api/cases/{case_id}/attachments creates an attachment from a unified payload (legacy per-type shapes are rejected with 400), and PUT /api/cases/{case_id}/attachments/{id} fully replaces one, with the document id taken from the path. Unlike the v1 comments routes, which return the whole case, the new routes return only the created or replaced attachment (201 and 200). Both routes are access: 'internal', so they are not public yet, and the diff has no UI or settings changes.
ad5a6dd1-f637-49f7-a50a-651e55776324.reasoning: Server-side routes, schemas, and tests only, and the routes are marked internal, so there's no published API or UI to document yet.

bdfd3071-3535-44c6-a9eb-f339166f70e5.suggestedTitle: List and get case attachments of any type with the new unified attachments API (internal)
bdfd3071-3535-44c6-a9eb-f339166f70e5.summary: Adds the read path of the new unified attachments API for Cases: GET /api/cases/{case_id}/attachments lists attachments with page, perPage, sortOrder, and an optional type filter, and GET /api/cases/{case_id}/attachments/{id} returns a single attachment in the unified shape. The find logic no longer assumes comments only and now resolves any attachment type across both storage models. The routes are access: 'internal', so they are not public yet, and no UI changes are included.
bdfd3071-3535-44c6-a9eb-f339166f70e5.reasoning: Server-side routes, schemas, and tests only, and the routes are marked internal, so there's no published API or UI to document yet.

08692a21-f0d5-4a4e-9ccb-bc3299cdc762.suggestedTitle: Delete one or all case attachments with the new unified attachments API (internal)
08692a21-f0d5-4a4e-9ccb-bc3299cdc762.summary: Adds the delete path of the new unified attachments API for Cases: DELETE /api/cases/{case_id}/attachments/{id} deletes one attachment and DELETE /api/cases/{case_id}/attachments deletes every attachment on the case, both returning 204. Behavior matches the existing comments delete routes, which stay unchanged. The routes are access: 'internal' until the API is ready to ship, and the diff has no UI changes.
